note: Published Election Commission of India result. `p` is the winning party code (data/parties.json, matched by the party's full name in the report's table 3, or by abbreviation where table 3 gives none; otherwise the ECI abbreviation reduced to its letters and digits) and `v` its total votes (general + postal); `o` is every other party's votes in the AC, summed by the same code, NOTA included. Keys are AC numbers as the boundary set carries them. `no_result` lists ACs this report carries no result for.
